Identified: [[Tamás Papp]] (light-blue shirt, pointing at lane 8; same face as his community-card portrait). Other bowlers, including a man with glasses in a light tee, are not named.

The 2023 Naboo Regionals ("Foil Fest") weekend in Liverpool, UK (2–4 June 2023), hosted by Team Wales.

* '''Event:''' [[2023 Regional Championships]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2023-05-31
* '''Identification:''' [[Tamás Papp]] (light-blue shirt, pointing at lane 8; same face as his community-card portrait). Other bowlers, including a man with glasses in a light tee, are not named.
